scopeExclusions.reason: Historical experiment limitations describe recorded evidence, not extra delivered behavior. Current M3 behaviors are separately audited.
dependOnIdentity convenience/brand API remains experimental; explicit id reads are audited.
Positive class support and production cache/eviction/scale are deferred or not currently exposed; visible class rejection is audited.
Arbitrary JS closure/I/O/time sandboxing and mathematical SHA collision freedom are explicitly not claims. No corresponding universal tests are required.

optionalAdditionalCombinations: Multiple forwarded origins in one call
Array-origin reorder combined with unrelated supplied implementation replacement
Concurrent parent resolutions combined with rollback
conclusions: Optional combinations are not counted as missing mandatory clauses. Known divergences remain open issue work. A glossary owner-routing gap is distinguished from an implementation mismatch.
